intro: Between April and August 2026, ZCyberNews published 14 articles tagged macOS, spanning April 10 to August 19. Coverage documented activity by Lazarus Group, ClickFix, and Sapphire Sleet, with technical detail on CVE-2026-65400 (CVSS 9.8), CVE-2024-54529, and CVE-2025-31235. Reporting focused on technology, cryptocurrency, artificial-intelligence, finance, and individual users across Global, Asia, Europe, North America, and South Asia. The severity mix included two critical and nine high-severity incidents, with two rated medium.
